description: Agent Recovery: submit a system’s retry behavior: the standing retry plan (whether it is written down, the most attempts, how attempts are spaced, the first and longest wait, how long retrying may go on, the failures never retried, what happens when retrying stops and who hears, and whether rate-limit waits are honored), optionally the calls that retry with whether each follows the plan, its own attempt limit and whether it charges, sends, books or writes, and the failures the system sees with whether retrying can fix each and whether it is retried. The signed report states the plan’s headline (attempts, spacing and stop point) and names no plan, no bound on attempts or time, a stop nobody hears of, every failure retrying cannot fix that is retried and every call retrying without limit outside the plan, then a plan set only in code, retries at once, growing waits with no jitter, no never-retry list, a stop only logged or told to no one named, rate-limit waits ignored, every call on its own terms and every state-changing call retried, with the fix for each. This reads the standing plan across calls: whether one retry of a specific payment or refund flow can charge twice is wever_retry-safety-check, whether a resumed or retried task repeats a message, order, record or booking is wever_duplicate-effect-check and where a handed-off task goes when its receiver fails is wever_handoff-failure-check. A summary sample is wever_retry-plan-sample on https://weverlabs.com/mcp-free. Verdict retries_blind, retry_plan_gaps, retry_plan_unverified or retry_plan_stated. POST /api/retry-plan-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-recovery-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-recovery/.

calls.description: Calls that retry, with any behavior of their own.

changes_state.description: The call charges, sends, books or writes, so repeating it repeats its effect.

follows_plan.description: The call retries under the standing plan.

max_attempts.description: The most attempts this call makes on its own terms, the first included.

name.description: The call, such as hotel search.

failures.description: Failures the system sees, with whether each is retried.

kind.description: The failure, such as timeout, rate limited or card declined.

permanent.description: Retrying cannot fix it: the request is refused, invalid or not allowed.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

delay.description: The wait before the first retry, such as 2 seconds.

honors_retry_after.description: Retries wait as long as a rate-limit response asks.

max_attempts.description: The most attempts per call, the first included.

max_delay.description: The longest wait between attempts, such as 1 minute.

never_retry.description: Failures never retried, such as card declined, invalid request or not authorized.

on_give_up.description: What happens when retrying stops: a named person is told, a team channel is told, it is only logged, or nothing happens.

spacing.description: How attempts are spaced: at once, at a fixed interval, with growing waits, or with growing waits and random jitter.

stop_after.description: How long retrying may go on in all before it stops, such as 10 minutes.

tell.description: Who hears when retrying stops, such as the on-call engineer.

written.description: The plan is written down where the operator can read it, not only set in code.

system.description: The system that retries, such as the booking agent.

name: wever_retry-plan-check
title: Retry plan check
